Alger, 20 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 20, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The operator Djezzy presented its new B2B brand, Djezzy Solutions, in Algiers on November 18, 2026. This initiative includes 15 digital services and the announcement of an electronic payment license by the Bank of Algeria.
Lancement de la marque Djezzy Solutions: Launch of the Djezzy Solutions brand
L'opérateur de téléphonie mobile Djezzy: Mobile operator Djezzy officially unveiled its new commercial entity, "Djezzy Solutions," during a ceremony held on November 18, 2026, at the Sheraton Club des Pins hotel in Algiers. This initiative marks a milestone in the company's transformation, as it aims to go beyond its traditional telecommunications scope to become an integrated digital services provider. Executive management, represented by Boumediene Senouci, presented a range of fifteen technological solutions intended for Algerian businesses and institutions.
L'offre s'articule autour de plusieurs a: The offering is built around several strategic pillars: cloud computing, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, customer relationship management, and call centers. Businesses can access elastic computing resources, storage, and managed databases. A digital marketplace complements this infrastructure by offering software tailored to specific business needs. All of these services rely on Djezzy's cloud infrastructure, ensuring data hosting and processing exclusively within national territory. This choice aims to strengthen digital sovereignty and the security of client organizations' information.
Parallèlement au lancement de cette offr: Alongside the launch of this technological offering, the CEO announced the obtention of a financial electronic payment service provider license from the Bank of Algeria. This authorization is part of a strategy aimed at diversifying the operator's activities and contributing to financial inclusion. Djezzy is currently finalizing procedures for the operational rollout of these financial services.
Pour construire ce catalogue, Djezzy s'a: To build this catalog, Djezzy relies on collaborations with the local ecosystem, notably the public accelerator Algeria Venture and Algerian startups. The company BortoCall, for example, developed two tools integrated into the offering: the Confy videoconferencing solution and the Relay encrypted professional messaging system. Boumediene Senouci emphasized the importance of supporting national skills to accompany the country's economic transformation.
Djezzy lance Djezzy Solutions le 18 nove: Djezzy launches Djezzy Solutions on November 18, 2026, in Algiers.
L'offre comprend 15 services numériques: The offering includes 15 digital services, including cloud and AI.
Les données sont hébergées dans des cent: Data is hosted in Algerian data centers.
Djezzy a obtenu un agrément de paiement: Djezzy obtained an electronic payment license from the Bank of Algeria.
Des partenariats sont noués avec Algeria: Partnerships are formed with Algeria Venture and the startup BortoCall.
